attrs.summary: **Important** Claude 3 Haiku reached end of life on September 10, 2026 in most Regions, where requests now fail with ResourceNotFoundException: This model version has reached the end of its life. It remains available in the Legacy stage in ap-northeast-2 (Seoul), ap-south-1 (Mumbai), ap-southeast-1 (Singapore), ca-central-1 (Canada), eu-central-2 (Zurich), and sa-east-1 (São Paulo). These Regions have an upcoming end of life of November 13, 2026, after which requests in these Regions will also fail. For models that are currently available, see Models at a glance. For how model lifecycle stages work, see Model lifecycle. Claude 3 Haiku is Anthropic's fastest and most compact Claude 3 model, optimized for speed and efficiency in near-instant responses. For more information about model development and performance, see the model/service card.
